title: Learning loop: bounded bucket sizing re-learned every Sunday (walk-forward, guardrails)
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: the bot must learn from its losses and change, without overfitting or blowing the eval.
verdict: not better on both 2026 halves (H1: funded; H2: net, funded, p10): ships in OBSERVE mode (logs proposals, applies nothing). 2026 H1 n=80 3.12/wk win 22.5% PF 4.58 net +36,862 ($6,048/mo) DD -2,513; eval 2wk 39.8/3.1 (dec10 42.9), 3wk 53.1/4.7, 1mo 65.6/6.2, pass rate 92.7%, median 10.5 sessions, slow_pass 33.3%; funded +35,984 (base +37,046, eval-path base +33,305). 2026 H2 n=40 2.56/wk win 35.0% PF 2.61 net +10,050 ($2,706/mo) DD -1,496; eval 2wk 23.1/0.0 (dec10 23.1), 3wk 34.6/0.0, 1mo 47.4/0.0, pass rate 100.0%, median 20.0 sessions, slow_pass 62.5%; funded +11,548 (base +11,659, eval-path base +10,465). 2021-25 reference n=510 2.38/wk win 17.5% PF 0.98 net -1,430 ($-28/mo) DD -17,694; eval 2wk 8.8/8.1 (dec10 16.9), 3wk 12.6/13.5, 1mo 15.8/20.8, pass rate 30.7%, median 16.5 sessions, slow_pass 52.5%; funded +4,252 (base +4,252, eval-path base -1,430).
notes: tools/lit_learn_replay.py + engine/lit_learn.py: knobs of each Sunday's review applied to the next week's trades (only trades that finished before the Sunday). Eval sizing $800/25 + weekly stop + learned multiplier in one rounding, $900 risk cap on a size-up, 60% room cap; MFFU 50K back to back.

learner.never_changes: stops, targets, entries, the LIT setup rules, the weekly stop, the Monday rule

method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
